parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.
> If you set this parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, you must also specify the **NodeId** parameter.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format (UTC). > The end time must be within 24 hours from the start time. Otherwise, the call fails.

parameters.name: LogicalOperator
parameters.description:
The logical operator for keyword-based search.
Default value: and.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the mongos or shard node in the sharded cluster instance.

> This parameter is available only if you set the **DBInstanceId** parameter to instance ID of a sharded cluster instance.

parameters.name: OrderType
parameters.description:
The order in which the returned running logs are sorted by time. Valid values:
- asc: ascending order.
- desc: descending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **30** to **100**.

parameters.name: QueryKeywords
parameters.description: The keywords for the query. Separate multiple keywords with spaces. You can specify up to 10 keywords.

parameters.name: RoleId
parameters.description: The role ID of the node. You can call [DescribeReplicaSetRole](~~62134~~) to query the role ID.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The role of the node in the instance. Valid values:
- **primary**: primary node.
- **secondary**: secondary node.
- **search**: search node.

> If you set the **NodeId** parameter to the ID of a mongos node, the value of **RoleType** can only be **primary**.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format (UTC).
